title: Redundant Items
description: Removes redundant items to improve simplicity and reduce inventory clutter with all changes toggleable in the config
body:
Sick of a messy inventory? Redundant Items cleans up Minecraft by merging all those extra items you just don't need. Say goodbye to seeds, now you just plant the crops directly! All your meats and fish are combined into simple "Raw Meat" and "Raw Fish" items, and annoying things like nuggets and charcoal are replaced by ingots and coal.

We've even changed how loot works: you'll get dyes straight from flowers unless you use a hoe to pick the flower up. You can even cook rotten flesh into steak! Everything is fully configurable so you can play how you want. These are some of the main features but Redundant Items has more to offer and is open to YOUR ideas.
